records.description: Need a high-converting launch poster, social media banner, or game graphic without spending a dime? records.name: ForkliftAI™ Copilot
records.tagline: AI warehouse decisions before delays become costly
records.description: ForkliftAI™ is an independent warehouse operations prototype that transforms simulated operational signals into clear, actionable decisions. It combines live congestion monitoring, equipment-health visibility, multi-distribution-center controls, recovery tracking, automated recommendations, guided workflows, and printable reports in one command center. It helps teams identify developing bottlenecks before they become costly delays.

records.name: MConnect
records.tagline: A Dynamic Email Builder from beautiful templates
records.description: Unlike standard email builders, MConnect eliminates external campaign tools: - Direct Client Paste: Copy responsive HTML straight into Gmail/Outlook with zero formatting glitches. - Live Dynamic Fields: Inject recipient variables, pricing, and CTAs with real-time previews. - Brand Styling: Auto-apply custom hex palettes, logos, and legal details. - Studio Lifecycle Templates: Pre-built for creative contracts, releases, quotations, and asset delivery.

records.name: NetPeek Pro
records.tagline: Catch intermittent network issues before they disappear
records.description: NetPeek Pro is a Windows network monitoring and diagnostics tool built to catch intermittent connection problems that are difficult to reproduce. It continuously monitors Internet connectivity, DNS, latency, packet loss, short outages, and custom websites or TCP services, while keeping history, incident timelines, comparisons, alerts, and exportable reports. More products on Microsoft Store Please copy the link below: https://apps.microsoft.com/search/publisher?name=AdamYang&hl=en-US&gl=US

records.name: Blueprint Generator
records.tagline: Turn your idea into a production-ready software blueprint
records.description: Stop jumping from idea straight into code. Blueprint Generator helps developers turn raw ideas into structured software blueprints covering architecture, database, APIs, authentication, security, deployment, testing, and more. Built for developers using AI who want to move faster without sacrificing design, security, performance, or scalability. Free to start. Pro and Lifetime plans available.

records.name: BioSocrates S3
records.tagline: AI scientist discovering cures with Socratic logic
records.description: BioSocrates S3 is the first AI scientist that reasons like Socrates to discover cures. Unlike black-box AI, it uses Socratic questioning + 3-stage reasoning to explain every hypothesis, predict drug-target interactions, and generate novel compounds. Built for researchers in Africa & globally. Open source, 100% transparent, lab-ready. We turn questions into cures.

records.name: Quill & Tankard
records.tagline: Run your D&D game from one browser tab. No account needed.
records.description: Quill & Tankard is a session toolkit for 5e DMs, built to run games from behind the screen. Play sounds, track initiative, manage your roster, and pull up items, all in one browser tab, saved locally with no account. This is a first release: four core Tools today, with more coming based on what DMs ask for. No sign-up, no install. Open a tab and run your game.

records.name: PrompTax - Stocks and Options CGT tool
records.tagline: AI-powered UK Capital Gains Tax software for accountants
records.description: PrompTax turns messy broker statements into HMRC-ready Capital Gains Tax reports. Upload multi-broker, multi-currency PDFs or CSVs — AI extracts every trade so you verify the output, not retype it into a spreadsheet. Then it applies the full HMRC waterfall — Same-Day, 30-Day Bed & Breakfast (cross-year aware), Section 104 pooling — plus equity options rules (S144/S148) most CGT tools can't touch. Out comes an SA108-ready PDF with a full audit trail and SHA-256 tamper-evident verification.

records.name: Dash to Cart 2.0
records.tagline: Hyperlightweight DTC commerce with built-in discovery
records.description: Dash to Cart 2.0 is rebuilt from the ground up around one idea: commerce should stay lightweight. Launch your store, get discovered through Dash to Cart Discovery, sync eligible products with Google Merchant Centre, manage Stripe-powered payments and refunds, and handle tax, shipping and pickup in one place. Go deeper with analytics, forecasting, email tracking and AI without stitching together a heavyweight commerce stack.

records.name: AskTruffle
records.tagline: Plain-English answers about your product, right in Slack
records.description: Truffle is an AI teammate that answers plain-English questions about your codebase, in Slack. Connect your repos, docs and APIs once, then anyone (support, PM, sales, success — not just engineers) can @-mention Truffle and ask how something works. It answers in plain English and cites its sources, so you can trust it. No commands, no setup, nothing to learn. Free for one user with your own AI key, or $49/mo for the whole team. Stop routing every "how does this work?" question through engineers.

records.name: Virtual Song Book
records.tagline: Share your band's sheet music
records.description: Virtual Song Book replaces binders of paper sheet music with a secure digital library for your whole band. Upload PDF scores and MP3s, and each musician sees only their assigned parts on a phone or tablet, online or off. Adjust tempo, add private annotations, and build sets for any gig. Concert Mode lets a director control what appears on every musician's device, live. Invite-only, with screen capture fully blocked. Try it free for 7 days.

records.name: Assist
records.tagline: Voice annotate your Mac, get screenshots + clipboard manager

records.name: Tripura Soft X Native Builder : 360Buidl
records.tagline: Top Construction Project management software 2026 Nepal
records.description: Construction companies manage far more than buildings. They manage people, materials, vendors, budgets, drawings, BOQs, schedules, site activities, documents and decisions. Yet many construction businesses still depend on a combination of Excel, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, phone calls, PDFs and paper records. That creates one major challenge:Information becomes fragmented. That is the problem Tripura Soft is trying to solve with 360Build. Nepal-based technology company established in August 2026.

records.name: Therapeutical.ai
records.tagline: mental health, agentic development, ai
records.description: AI agents run at machine speed; people do not. As mental strain rises, goals blur, reviews get shallower, attempts repeat, and tokens keep burning. Therapeutical AI is an AI-powered VS Code extension that combines these work signals with brief mental-strain check-ins to predict whether another two hours of agentic development will be worth it—then recommends continuing, resetting, taking a break, or stopping. Code and prompts are never uploaded.

records.name: DataSort
records.tagline: Clean, merge, and dedupe messy Excel files in your browser
records.description: Most Excel cleaners make you select the columns and hope. DataSort reads the file the way a person would: it finds the real header row buried under junk rows, catches fuzzy duplicates ("Jon Smith" vs "John Smith") rather than only exact matches, and merges files whose columns are named differently by mapping them itself. No install and no signup to try. Files are processed in memory and never stored. The free plan handles files up to 500 rows.

records.name: Battery Health Lab
records.tagline: Free Windows battery report analyzer for healthier laptops
records.description: Battery Health Lab turns a technical Windows battery report into a simple health assessment. Upload your report to understand current capacity, estimated wear, and whether replacement may be worth considering. It is free, requires no account, and gives everyday laptop users clear, practical guidance.

records.name: Porkast
records.tagline: Follow keywords, not shows. Living podcast feeds for iOS.
records.description: Porkast turns keywords like #SpaceX, #DeepSeek, or #OpenAI into living podcast feeds — every relevant new episode from the 4M+ Apple Podcasts catalog lands in one place, automatically. • Follow topics, not shows across 4M+ Apple Podcasts • Export any topic feed, playlist, or backlog as standard RSS • Jump straight to chapters & timeline scrubbing • Curate themed playlists & Listen Later queues • Native Swift & SwiftUI for iOS 18+ · English & 简体中文 • Free forever tier: 5 keyword feeds, zero ads

records.name: Landstats Property App

records.name: Pythonize

No account, no subscription — one link, $12.99 one-time.

records.name: Pantry Inventory App for Restaurants

Built withNET, SQLite, and Linux, and developed in public. 🚀 Try it: https://pantryinventoryapp.com/ If you run a food business, I'd love your feedback. For: IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, Android Studio, Cursor, VS Code, Visual Studio and many more.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: The VPN-free parental control that kids can't bypass.
records.description: GuardianParental is an open-source Android app (8-15) that operates as Device Owner to block any app's internet (YouTube, WhatsApp, etc) on WiFi/4G/Hotspot with 0 KB/s - no VPN, no pop-ups. Key: Stealth by default (no icon), only opens via secret dialer code *#9999#. Schedule blocks (4-7 PM), AES-256 PIN, survives reboot. 6.65 MB APK, MIT license. Tested: Vivo Y12s Android 11 ✅ YouTube fully blocked. Samsung Android 15: community help needed. GitHub: https://github.com/aghdetngf/GuardianParental

records.name: B2B Revenue & Ops Engine
records.tagline: Build systemic infrastructure, not charming apologies.
records.description: Most founders waste time building just content systems when they actually need full business operations and revenue engines. This is a complete blueprint to architect your layered B2B revenue systems. Stop relying on manual fixes. Deploy a robust systemic delivery pipeline that automates client acquisition, streamlines core workflows, and scales your corporate outreach effectively.

records.name: PR Lens by Coldtea.ai
records.tagline: See code through a new lens
records.description: PR Lens is a new way to look at code. It draws animated architecture and data flow diagrams of any codebase and every pull request, so you see the change before you read a single line of code. It runs as a GitHub Action, on the CLI, or as a skill for your coding agent. Open source under MIT.

records.name: Bloop
records.tagline: Turn any Mac audio into a visual you can actually export
records.description: Bloop turns system audio or mic input into eight real-time shader skins - every frame reacts to what's actually playing. Keep it beside your work in the resizable Mini Player or send it to the menu bar. Drop in an MP3 playlist and export the whole thing as a finished video. Apple Silicon, notarized, no subscription. Two skins are free forever, and they're the full app, not a trial.

records.name: Assist
records.tagline: Voice annotate your Mac, get screenshots + clipboard manager
records.description: Annotate your Mac screen with voice, capture full-screen screenshots, and keep copied text ready to reuse from the notch.

records.name: Routines by Databox
records.tagline: An AI Analyst that runs analysis and reports on a schedule
records.description: Give your AI Analyst a prompt and a schedule. It analyzes your live data, prepares the report or analysis you asked for, and delivers it by email, Slack, or in-app. The recurring work you do by hand today gets done automatically.

records.name: Scriptly
records.tagline: An iOS teleprompter app controlled by your voice
records.description: Write, organize, and record videos effortlessly with Scriptly. Featuring real-time voice-following scrolling, local storage privacy, and professional teleprompter tools. Download the public beta on TestFlight.

records.name: Clipnote
records.tagline: Save your AI conversations so they persist after closing tab
records.description: Your ChatGPT and Claude conversations disappear the moment you close the tab. With Clipnote, just tell your AI to "save this" and it's kept on the spot — pasting it in works too, of course. It's a place to keep your AI conversations like a notepad, come back to them later, and pick up right where you left off.

records.name: Airuncode
records.tagline: Run multiple local coding agents on your machine
records.description: Airuncode is a local-first agent runtime for serious software work. Run multiple coding agents on your machine, bring your own API keys, switch between cloud and local models, and pay providers directly with zero token markup. It scans your codebase, debates solutions across agents, edits files, runs tests and self-heals failures. It also ships with V-CORE, a native Vulkan 3D runtime for AI-assisted game development. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: Remind
records.tagline: Full-screen meeting reminders with AI briefings
records.description: Remind puts your next meeting on every screen, with an AI briefing on who you are meeting and a one-click join button. Stay focused until it is time to join. Connect Google or Microsoft calendars and bring relevant email, Slack, and Notion context into your meeting prep. For macOS 14+. $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Nina by Antalpha
records.tagline: Non-custodial AI Agent: research, predict & trade crypto
records.description: Nina is a non-custodial AI trading assistant by Antalpha (NASDAQ: ANTA). Unlike generic chatbots, it's wired to institutional-grade, real-time data and answers conclusion-first, with charts—not walls of text. Ask in plain language; Nina drafts the trade, prediction, or safety check—you sign on your own wallet. One chat now covers crypto and US stocks: market intel, smart-money tracking, predictions & Polymarket, wallet-safety checks—plus Sentinel 24/7 alerts and MCP for any AI client.

records.name: Tucky
records.tagline: Notes docked to your screen edge, with an AI agent inside
records.description: Tucky is a native macOS notes app that sleeps as a thin stripe on the screen edge. Local and encrypted. Plus is $4/month for voice, connectors, and the best LLM models.
